item.description:
**Company Description**
At SAP, you will be part of a global environment that values shared learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will work across international teams, exchange knowledge openly, and develop alongside colleagues committed to advancing machine learning engineering practices. SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level.
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring** You have hands-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems.
* Python proficiency and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large-scale columnar data stores. * End-to-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role.
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates to be comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI. Candidates should be able to create effective inputs. They must automate routine tasks and evaluate the quality of AI-generated outputs. Additionally, they should promote the adoption of AI practices within their teams.
**What you'll build** You will build and maintain ML systems that power personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees, covering offline pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops.
* Build and maintain offline ML pipelines for signal extraction, feature engineering, and candidate generation. * Contribute to request-time ranking logic that fuses signals from multiple ML routes into a personalized result. * Extract and transform employee signals; skills, proficiency, and learning history, into reusable, scenario-agnostic feature snapshots. * Design and maintain quality gates that validate ML pipeline outputs before they reach the serving layer. * Build the experimentation infrastructure. This includes A/B schemas, offline evaluation, and ablation testing. These tools will help measure improvements accurately and thoroughly. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Architects, and Product to refine algorithms and ship end-to-end ML systems.
**Where you belong** You will join a small, high-ownership pod building personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees at scale. The team runs offline ML pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops in production, processing signals from millions of employees. You will work directly alongside Data Scientists, Architects, and Product from day one, shipping end-to-end ML systems.
**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

Uber One is Uber's flagship membership program, serving more than 50 million members globally across Mobility, Delivery, Grocery, and other Uber experiences. Membership combines savings, benefits, priority experiences, and exclusive offerings while driving engagement, cross-platform adoption, and long-term retention.
As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build product-focused ML systems for targeting, personalization, offers, and member engagement. Your models will directly influence the Membership experiences consumers see across Uber and Uber Eats.
What You Will Do
* Own targeting and personalization models from problem framing through deployment and monitoring.
* Build treatment-effect and uplift models to estimate incremental impact of Membership interventions.
* Design budget-aware allocation systems for consumer offers under real business constraints.
* Build ranking and sequencing models for Membership messaging across Mobility and Delivery.
* Productionize models in real-time serving paths and large-scale batch pipelines.
* Design and analyze experiments to measure incremental product impact.
* Translate ambiguous Membership growth problems into concrete ML solutions with cross-functional partners.
Basic Qualifications
* 3+ years of experience building and shipping production ML models.
* Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM.
* Strong understanding of SQL and large-scale data processing experience with Spark, Hive, Presto, or similar technologies.
* Experience with experimental design, A/B testing, and measurement of noisy product outcomes.
* Experience working on ML systems from offline development through serving, monitoring, and retraining.
* Experience applying ML to user-facing product or business decisions.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience applying ML to membership, subscription, growth, or consumer engagement products.
* Experience with uplift modeling, treatment effects, ranking, recommendation, or sequential decision systems.
* Experience with constrained optimization, incentives, promotions, pricing, or offer targeting at consumer scale.
* Strong product mindset with experience translating consumer needs and business constraints into measurable ML outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or Marketing on complex product decisions.
* Familiarity with subscription metrics including conversion, retention, LTV, cannibalization, and incrementality.

* Experience in building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production. * Experience in distributed Machine Learning and Machine Learning infrastructure, distributed systems and with Machine Learning algorithms at scale. * Experience in designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience in Machine Learning model development and deployment frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (e.g., TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g., encoders, decoders, transformers), or APIs. * Experience in search and information retrieval.
**About the job** -----------------
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
As a (TL) Technical Lead, you will work on improving Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and end-to-end solutions to empower live recommendations and grow live ecosystems responsibly. You will set up growth metrics and goals, conduct analysis and research to identify growth areas, and lead a team of engineers to iterate experiments toward launch.
Additionally, you will communicate across YouTube engineering teams and leads, to align with the design direction and future plans of your projects. In this position, you will work with YouTube Discovery teams (e.g., Home, Shorts, WatchNext, Notifications, Living Room), Live Infrastructure, and Live Experience teams, and collaborate with Google DeepMind, YouTube Knowledge, and YouTube Trust and Safety (TnS) teams.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

item.description:
**Description** AWS Elemental builds media services used by broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video. Elemental Inference is the applied machine learning team within that organization. We develop models that understand and transform live and file-based video, producing capabilities such as intelligent reframing, highlight detection, video enhancement, and contextual metadata for advertising and content discovery. Our work reaches customers through the same media workflows that carry major live events, always-on channels, and large on-demand libraries.
As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will develop new machine learning approaches and carry the strongest ideas into production. Current work spans multimodal video, audio, and language models; spatial and temporal understanding; active-speaker and point-of-interest detection; scene retrieval; video super-resolution; and learned methods for improving compression. These problems rarely have a single accepted metric or a ready-made dataset. You will help define the task itself, determine what evidence is needed, and build evaluation methods that reflect the experience of people watching and working with the resulting video.
This role combines applied research with the practical demands of a real-time media service. You will design datasets and objectives, train models at scale, run controlled comparisons, and investigate failures. You will also work closely with engineers to export, optimize, and deploy those models. A result is not finished when it performs well in a notebook. It must preserve its quality after conversion, fit within GPU memory, meet latency and throughput targets, handle the temporal behavior of live video, and operate at a cost customers can sustain.
You will be a technical leader on the team as well as an individual contributor. The role calls for someone who can take an ambiguous customer problem, separate the scientific questions from the engineering constraints, and lead a team toward a defensible answer. You will review experiments and models, mentor other scientists and engineers, and improve the shared methods the team uses for training and evaluation. Strong judgment matters here. So does the ability to explain a complicated result clearly, including its limitations, to people from several disciplines.
We welcome candidates with deep experience in computer vision, multimodal learning, video processing, or related areas. Direct media experience is valuable but not required. A scientist who has solved difficult problems in another field, understands how to test ideas rigorously, and wants to learn the video domain can also succeed in this role.
Key job responsibilities
Lead the formulation of ambiguous video problems into research plans with clear datasets, objectives, baselines, evaluation protocols, and production acceptance criteria.
Develop models for multimodal video understanding and generation, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression.
Develop models for multimodal video understanding and description, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression.
Build evaluations that measure the behavior customers will see. Depending on the problem, this may include task accuracy, factual support, temporal localization, retrieval quality, perceptual video quality, rate-distortion performance, or human review.
Take models from research code to production-ready artifacts. Partner with engineers on model export, reduced-precision inference, quantization, numerical parity, accelerator-specific optimization, and integration with serving systems and video pipelines.
Balance model quality against latency, throughput, GPU memory, context limits, and operating cost. Diagnose problems across training stability, data quality, precision, compilation, serving, and live temporal behavior.
Build reusable mechanisms for dataset management, experimentation, model comparison, regression detection, and performance measurement rather than solving each research problem in isolation.
Review scientific work and production code. Identify weak comparisons, data leakage, unsupported conclusions, untested edge cases, and operational risks before they reach customers.
Work with product managers, software engineers, and other scientists to make scope and design decisions. Use evidence to resolve disagreement and communicate what is known, what remains uncertain, and what further work is worth doing.
Mentor scientists and engineers in experimental design, machine learning methods, video evaluation, and production ML practices.
Contribute applied research through internal technical reports, patents, and publications at appropriate conferences or workshops.
**About The Team** AWS Elemental provides a portfolio of cloud media services built to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video at global scale. Our technology supports some of the world's largest live broadcasts as well as 24/7 channels and on-demand content. The broader organization brings together expertise in video coding, image processing, distributed systems, advertising, and the operational demands of professional media.
Elemental Inference applies machine learning across that video pipeline. The team works on video understanding and enhancement, contextual metadata, smart composition, event detection, retrieval, and compression. Some projects use large multimodal models that combine video, audio, and language. Others use specialized temporal or spatial models designed for a narrow task and a strict real-time budget. We choose the approach that fits the customer problem rather than forcing every problem into the same model family.
Scientists on the team own more than model architecture. They build and govern datasets, develop annotation methods, train on distributed GPU infrastructure, and create evaluations that can reveal where a model succeeds or fails. They compare internal models with external alternatives and track accuracy, perceptual quality, latency, memory use, and cost. When a model is ready to ship, scientists work with engineers to convert it into a verified production artifact and integrate it into the inference service or the underlying video-processing engine.

**Preferred Qualifications**

A central mandate is to define and build a durable company-level causal value metric: a trusted, long-term signal that estimates the incremental value created by product, growth, and marketplace actions. The metric will connect experiments, observational evidence, and production ML so leaders and product teams can compare investments on a common basis while protecting customer experience and marketplace health.
**About The Role** You will set the multi-year technical direction for causal ML, lead the pod’s portfolio and operating model, and remain close to the hardest modeling and systems work. You will be accountable for both scientific credibility and production impact.
**You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…**
* Lead the Causal ML pod across technical strategy, architecture, execution, and quality. Create a roadmap that joins foundational platform work with high-value product applications. * Define the company-level causal value metric and its measurement framework, including the target construct, time horizon, component outcomes, identification strategy, calibration, uncertainty, and guardrails. * Build the metric into a decision system that teams can use for product prioritization, experiment readouts, intervention selection, budget allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs. * Establish how randomized experiments, quasi-experiments, observational estimation, and learned models work together. Make the limits of each source of evidence explicit. * Architect reusable causal capabilities for treatment effect estimation, surrogate validation, counterfactual policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, and long-term outcome forecasting. * Guide production applications across promotions, lifecycle interventions, ranking, recommendations, search, substitutions, demand shaping, and inventory-aware discovery. * Set standards for validation, monitoring, reproducibility, and governance so causal estimates remain reliable as policies, populations, and marketplace conditions change. * Influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Strategy, and business teams by translating complex causal evidence into clear decisions and tradeoffs. * Develop senior engineers and scientists through technical direction, design review, coaching, and a high bar for causal reasoning and engineering craft.
